headline: Google launches SynthID website to detect AI-generated media
summary: Google launched the SynthID website, letting anyone check whether an image, video, or audio clip was AI-generated. The detector flags content made with AI tools from companies including OpenAI, Google, and Apple, and is now available globally.

claims.statement: Google launched the SynthID website, which lets users check whether media was AI-generated.

sources.quote: lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI
Google's AI detection website is now available

claims.statement: SynthID Detector flags content created with AI tools from multiple companies, including OpenAI, Google, and Apple.

sources.quote: SynthID Detector will flag content created with AI tools from OpenAI, Google, Apple and other companies.
identify AI content from Google, OpenAI, and more

claims.statement: The detector is now available globally.

sources.quote: Google rolls out improved SynthID AI content detector, now available globally
